note: Seney Township's campground (Fox Park) on the banks of the Fox River off C.R. 450 at Seney, Schoolcraft County; the 27-mile Fox River Pathway starts at its western edge, with trailhead parking. Campers report no dump station (services are in town) and cash or check payment at about $15-20 a night; the township posts no rates. --Claude
summary: The only description is the Pure Michigan listing (the township has no website): 15 electric sites and 10 tent sites on the Fox River, 4 vault toilets, a flowing well, first-come first-served with no reservations; phone (906) 499-3491 (also on Google Maps: 4.5 stars / 65 reviews). Confirmed FCFS/no reservations, vault toilets and potable water as reported; added 25 sites; cleared the directory-only 30-amp and no-dump values. No fees or season published. Note trimmed of site counts, facilities and booking; the camper-reported rate kept and labelled.
flags: Missing phone and operator website: the entry has no phone; the campground's published number is (906) 499-3491 (michigan.org 'Local' line and Google Maps). Seney Township has no website of its own; its only official page is the county's township-board page https://www.schoolcraftcounty.net/government/township-boards/seney-township-board (Township Hall 906-499-3490, supervisor 906-499-3332). The stored website remains the michigan.org tourism listing, which is the only page describing the campground.
